text:
ashley: Spike summary: minimal loader API for safetensors sharded bundles. Key goals: optional manifest, safe atomic handoff, tiny in-header warmstart hints, and clear fallback rules.
raj: Good. Big risk is partial-read during a shard swap. We need a cheap finalization check before trusting offsets.
sophia: Proposal: three modes: index-first, stream-first, auto. In auto, prefer manifest for >200MB or when bundle tag warmup_priority=true. Otherwise stream-first.
dash: For hints: keep them compact. header.hint = base64(seed_bytes + map_crc32). No per-layer CRCs by default. Hints only used to build a lightweight WarmupPlan to prime KV cache.
ashley: API sketch: Loader.open(uri, {mode: "auto|index|stream"}) -> {handle_id, warmup_plan}. warmup_plan is a short list of byte ranges to prefetch (strings). Example: ["0:0-2MB","3:0-128KB"].
raj: Finalization: require either content-addressed object names or a .final marker/HTTP header. Ingesters must set finalize=true. Otherwise loader falls back to streaming with stricter read-time guards.
sophia: For private/on-prem without atomic rename, use a lease handshake: check <uri>.lock or <uri>.final. If missing, do streaming-only and emit telemetry.warmup_fallback=index_missing.
dash: Fallback behavior: if manifest fetch errors (404/timeout) switch to streaming and log warmup.fallback=index_miss. Do not fail the load.
ashley: Perf notes: manifest fetch ~10-15ms on S3; streaming first-chunk ~1ms but repeated readahead adds up. For multi-layer models manifest-first reduces total warmup latency. Small bundles (<100MB) often better with stream-first.
raj: Backcompat: many bundles lack hints. Default to stream-first for those. Provide a migration CLI: rwdx annotate-hint --finalize which writes a tiny hint sidecar or header patch and sets a finalize marker.
sophia: Telemetry events to emit: warmup.path=(index|stream), warmup.latency_ms, warmup.fallback=(none|index_miss|unfinalized). Send per-load. Optimize can use these to tune thresholds.
dash: infra-bot: ran unit spike tests on s3-emulator; all permutations OK. Branch spike/loader-hints. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/1278
ashley: Next: draft a short RFC with API, hint schema (max 1KB), finalize/lease requirements, and migration CLI. I'll circulate Friday.
raj: I'll add microbench for bundles 10MB-300MB to pick threshold.
sophia: I'll stub telemetry in Optimize to estimate cost and cache priming benefits.
ashley: thumbs up, closing spike notes.
